items.heading: Kabsa
details: Key ingredients: rice, chicken or lamb, tomato, baharat, nuts
Brown chicken or lamb with onion and baharat spice blend.
Add tomato and dried lime, simmering until tender.
Cook rice in the fragrant spiced broth.
Serve the rice topped with the meat, toasted nuts and raisins.

items.heading: Jareesh
details: Key ingredients: cracked wheat, chicken, onion, spices
Soak cracked wheat, then simmer it with chicken until soft.
Shred the chicken and return it to the pot.
Continue cooking, stirring, until the wheat breaks down into a thick porridge.
Season well and serve warm.
